source.title: Tester source address 0xF1 for JLR normal-fixed diagnostics (hypothesis)
source.origin: JLR Scanner reasoning: the SDD platform documents declare no tester address for their normal_fixed buses; ISO 15765-4 assigns 0xF1 to external test equipment for legislated OBD, and J2534 tooling uses it; ADR-0017
source.provenance: Research hypothesis; refuted or confirmed by a tester's first read on such a bus (ADR-0016)
source.notes: Every derived normal-fixed identifier cites this evidence, so every such record stays Unverified until a module answers.

locator.description: docs/adr/ADR-0017, Context and Decision 2: the tester address is not documented for JLR enhanced diagnostics; 0xF1 is assumed as for legislated OBD

evidence.excerpt: N_SA = 0xF1 assumed for the tester on L322 MY04.5-MY07, L319 MY05 and L320 MY06 normal_fixed buses
